summary: Completed testing of data usage optimizations for Railway deployment. Validated balance alerts now use 12h cooldowns (twice daily max), scheduler intervals drastically reduced, balance cache TTL increased from 45s to 5min, crypto currencies trimmed from 18 to 6, and reporting uses SQL aggregates instead of fetching all rows. All optimizations are working correctly to reduce data usage and API calls.

configuration_issues.issue: Fincra balance threshold in .env is ₦1000 but config.py default suggests ₦5000
configuration_issues.impact: Minor configuration inconsistency - alerts may trigger more frequently than intended

passed_tests: Balance alert cooldowns all set to 12h (twice daily max)
Reconciliation interval changed from 5min to 30min in consolidated_scheduler.py
Workflow runner interval changed from 90s to 5min in consolidated_scheduler.py
Crypto rate refresh interval changed from 5min to 15min in consolidated_scheduler.py
Promo messages interval changed from 30min to 2h in consolidated_scheduler.py
Fincra balance cache TTL increased from 45s to 300s in fincra_service.py
Kraken balance cache TTL increased from 45s to 300s in kraken_service.py
Reporting uses SQL aggregates (func.sum) instead of fetching all rows in reporting.py
Balance report no longer calls monitor_all_balances() avoiding duplicate API calls
Crypto rate currencies reduced from 18 to 6 core currencies in crypto_rate_background_refresh.py
monitor_all_balances uses cached data (force_fresh_for_critical=False) in balance_guard.py
Scheduler starts correctly with all optimized intervals
action_item_for_main_agent: Consider updating BALANCE_ALERT_FINCRA_THRESHOLD_NGN in .env from 1000 to 5000 for consistency with config.py default, but this is a minor configuration preference rather than a functional issue.
